data.name: StageDescription
data.value: This development build checks approved native libraries. Playback is currently exercised by the separate AudioSmoke tool. The player interface is the next milestone.

data.name: InitialStatus
data.value: Native libraries have not been checked. No audio starts automatically.

data.name: Checking
data.value: Checking library hashes and native versions…

data.name: Verified
data.value: Native load verified. Output-device and audible playback tests have not run.

data.name: Failed
data.value: Native check failed. Run scripts/Setup-Native.ps1, then retry. Details:

data.name: EmptyPrompt
data.value: Add local audio files or a folder to begin. No audio starts automatically.

data.name: EmptyPlaylist
data.value: Your playlist is empty. Add files or a folder.

data.name: SessionTemporary
data.value: This playlist is cleared when the application closes.

data.name: ImportCanceled
data.value: Import canceled. Already added items remain available.

data.name: ErrorFileUnavailable
data.value: This local file is missing, inaccessible or unavailable offline. Choose another file.

data.name: ErrorDecoder
data.value: This file could not be decoded. It may use an unsupported encoding or be damaged. Try another file; details show the decoder result.

data.name: ErrorDependency
data.value: An approved audio library is unavailable. Provision the native dependencies and retry.

data.name: ErrorOutputUnavailable
data.value: Windows default output is unavailable. Check your output device, then press Play to retry.

data.name: ErrorUnexpected
data.value: The operation failed. See technical details and retry.

data.name: ErrorBusy
data.value: Too many audio commands are pending. Retry the operation.

data.name: HelpText
data.value:
Space: Play/Pause (outside text and checkbox controls) Ctrl+O: Add files Ctrl+Shift+O: Add folder Ctrl+F: Search Enter: Play selected entry Delete: Remove selected entries (source files are preserved) Alt+Left / Alt+Right: Previous / Next Ctrl+Left / Ctrl+Right: Seek 5 seconds Ctrl+Up / Ctrl+Down: Volume 5 percentage points Esc: Clear search
This playlist is cleared when the application closes. Sources must be local and available offline. No internet requests are made by the application.
